privileged_info_for_vlm: The Artist table in the Chinook database contains 275 records. The fields are 'ArtistId' (integer) and 'Name' (text). The first few records are: 1 - AC/DC, 2 - Accept, 3 - Aerosmith. The report must be in landscape orientation and tabular format.
